title: Lois and the Aseptic

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Hey. Funny seeing you here. What brings you to the old port?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey. Funny seeing you here. What brings you to the old port?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could ask you the same thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could ask you the same thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could ask you the same thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could ask you the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None of your business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of your business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just exploring.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just exploring.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Right. Not... thinking about fleeing the planet to escape this mad serial killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Not... thinking about fleeing the planet to escape this mad serial killer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The thought had crossed my mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The thought had crossed my mind.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The thought had crossed my mind.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The thought had crossed my mind.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: What do you think he wants? Or she? Or them? Could be anyone, you know. All sorts of people can be serial killers. Even androids and Automata.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think he wants? Or she? Or them? Could be anyone, you know. All sorts of people can be serial killers. Even androids and Automata.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I mean an Automata probably needs a robotic frame to do it, but even then... I remember that rogue traffic Automata last month that killed like two hundred people just by flashing the wrong color at the wrong time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean an Automata probably needs a robotic frame to do it, but even then... I remember that rogue traffic Automata last month that killed like two hundred people just by flashing the wrong color at the wrong time.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I was making polite conversation bud. I just wanted to know if you needed any help or something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was making polite conversation bud. I just wanted to know if you needed any help or something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seriously?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I heard about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I heard about that.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: You did? I thought it was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You did? I thought it was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Yeah. It was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. It was kinda covered up by CorpSec. Gordon is a Corpster Hacker in his spare time and he told me about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So do you know anything about The Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So do you know anything about The Aseptic?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So do you know anything about The Aseptic?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So do you know anything about The Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Just what people say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just what people say.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Come on Lois. You can tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on Lois. You can tell me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Come on Lois. You can tell me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Come on Lois. You can tell me.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well, I get the feeling this killer has a plan. I mean, I know that's not much of a secret, but I feel like there is a pattern there, you know? We just can't see it yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I get the feeling this killer has a plan. I mean, I know that's not much of a secret, but I feel like there is a pattern there, you know? We just can't see it yet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think it's all random.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it's all random.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know what the pattern is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know what the pattern is.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know what the pattern is.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know what the pattern is.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Are you afraid?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you afraid?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's a pattern for sure, but I don't know what it is yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a pattern for sure, but I don't know what it is yet.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's a pattern for sure, but I don't know what it is yet.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's a pattern for sure, but I don't know what it is yet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Terrified.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Terrified.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a little worrying, but I think I will be fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a little worrying, but I think I will be fine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a little worrying, but I think I will be fine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a little worrying, but I think I will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't give it a second's thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't give it a second's thought.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't give it a second's thought.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't give it a second's thought.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I'm pretty anxious about it. But then, I'm pretty anxious about MOST things. Have you heard of that sentient slime mold that appears at the docks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm pretty anxious about it. But then, I'm pretty anxious about MOST things. Have you heard of that sentient slime mold that appears at the docks?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Sentient slime mold. It slithers up from the slump at midnight. Well, that's the rumor anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sentient slime mold. It slithers up from the slump at midnight. Well, that's the rumor anyway.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The what?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Sure. Why not? Sounds cool, in a terrifying kind of way. Anyway, want to hop in a shuttle with me? Luna sounds nice?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Why not? Sounds cool, in a terrifying kind of way. Anyway, want to hop in a shuttle with me? Luna sounds nice?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you believe that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you believe that?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: No, of course not. Unless you have a few million Lims in your back pocket?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, of course not. Unless you have a few million Lims in your back pocket?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seriously?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Haha, then our first trip to the moon will have to wait I guess. *Sigh* I just like to watch the shuttles take off. The ozone smell makes me think of...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, then our first trip to the moon will have to wait I guess. *Sigh* I just like to watch the shuttles take off. The ozone smell makes me think of...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do not.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Yeah, something like that. You gotta dream of something better than this, right? And the easiest way to do that, is to dream that somewhere else IS better than this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, something like that. You gotta dream of something better than this, right? And the easiest way to do that, is to dream that somewhere else IS better than this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Freedom?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Freedom?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Anywhere but here seems good right now. I need something to change...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anywhere but here seems good right now. I need something to change...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure Luna is great either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure Luna is great either.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure Luna is great either.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure Luna is great either.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: I dunno. My job, my family, my life... Something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno. My job, my family, my life... Something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Is that what YOU'RE doing? I dunno... Maybe it's just that time of the year, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that what YOU'RE doing? I dunno... Maybe it's just that time of the year, you know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Things will get better. You just have to wait it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Things will get better. You just have to wait it out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Things will get better. You just have to wait it out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Things will get better. You just have to wait it out.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: You know, when there's no big games coming out because all the season passes have started over again. I probably just need something new to play.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, when there's no big games coming out because all the season passes have started over again. I probably just need something new to play.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What time of the year?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What time of the year?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not into guns, but shooting people in games is fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not into guns, but shooting people in games is fun.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not into guns, but shooting people in games is fun.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not into guns, but shooting people in games is fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not really into guns either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not really into guns either.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not really into guns either.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not really into guns either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like all sorts of games, but I don't like shooting much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like all sorts of games, but I don't like shooting much.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like all sorts of games, but I don't like shooting much.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like all sorts of games, but I don't like shooting much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Real guns are cool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Real guns are cool.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Well anything that can keep my mind off these morbid serial killer stories is good. We should play some co-op games some time. You in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well anything that can keep my mind off these morbid serial killer stories is good. We should play some co-op games some time. You in?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd rather do something in the real world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd rather do something in the real world.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd rather do something in the real world.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd rather do something in the real world.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Alright. Well, I'm gonna let you get back to... whatever you are really doing. I'm gonna watch like three more launches, then I should go home and finish those bug reports.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. Well, I'm gonna let you get back to... whatever you are really doing. I'm gonna watch like three more launches, then I should go home and finish those bug reports.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bye Lois.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bye Lois.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not yet, but I'm working on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not yet, but I'm working on it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not yet, but I'm working on it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not yet, but I'm working on it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Opportunity?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Opportunity?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Coffee?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coffee?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Revolution?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Revolution?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Coffee? You're a strange one, and that's something, coming from me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coffee? You're a strange one, and that's something, coming from me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hear it's nice there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hear it's nice there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Things will only get better if you take control of your own life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Things will only get better if you take control of your own life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Things will only get better if you take control of your own life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Things will only get better if you take control of your own life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe there's more to life than games?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe there's more to life than games?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe there's more to life than games?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe there's more to life than games?

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Haha, good one. Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, good one. Maybe I should get into shooters? I'm just not that excited about guns though...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There are a lot of rumors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There are a lot of rumors.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There are a lot of rumors.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There are a lot of rumors.

nodes.speaker: Lois Gyo
nodes.text: Course. But do I believe this one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Course. But do I believe this one?
